Camera moves overridden from S9's frames/review.json editor_notes: s01 custom 1.0 to 1.06 looking down (y -1), so the lit phone stays at about the frame's own 78-85 % instead of the push-in's 84-91 %; s27 push-in focus y 0.7 so the palms stay at about 68-79 %; s40 custom 1.12 to 1.16 shifted right (x 0.68 to 0.4) to crop the empty chair and bag at the picture-right edge (keeps about x 2-91 % of the frame at the start). Arithmetic from camera.ts, not checked on a rendered still.
Voice fx: l02, l10, l11 phone (Mausi on a phone); l19 through_door (low-pass 5 kHz, loudness matched). No landing reverb on l07, l09, l12 (no reverb chain in the toolchain; not attempted).

Levels: the cue sheet's level_db is read as a target peak, so point gain = level_db - the file's max_db (library manifest). Beds: the bedroom bed at 0 dB (file mean -46 dB), as in s1e01; other beds offset from it by the sheet's level difference. mus_bed_drone -24 dB (as s1e01), mus_tension_pulse -26 dB (sheet 2 dB under the drone).

Ducking: the beds are on the music bus, so the global ducking (-8 dB, toolchain default) takes them and both music cues down under every line (sheet: beds 6, drone 8, pulse 6). l19 and l28 get a further -2 / -4 dB segment on the bedroom bed and the pulse (sheet: 10 and 12 dB).

sfx_boots_stairs_up (6 s rising file) is looped once over b3 from s04 to just after l06: trimmed so the second pass ends on its loudest step at l06's end; the first pass runs 10 dB lower so the wrap back to the quiet start does not drop. Low-passed 3 kHz. Stops dead, then the fist bang.
b7 car and keys low-passed (2.5 / 3.5 kHz) for the bedroom side; the keys rise in three 4 dB steps over s23 and stop 8 frames before s24, where the hasp crack (and the pulse) come in over the cut.
Dropped as optional on the cue sheet: the faint bangle chink with the print in b10 and the notebook tap on the photograph in b11 (b11 has no gap around l24 wider than 8 frames).
The paper crinkle and the bangle chink on l28 start in the pause between its two sentences, at about the s40/s41 cut; they run a little under 'अपने' / 'With' at -20 / -24 dB.
Nothing in this mix has been listened to; levels and placements are by measurement and arithmetic only.
